Returns candidate dating profiles filtered by sexual/gender preferences with age, city, distanceKm, sharedInterests, interestTags, and vibeScore.

item.name: Get Discovery People (Filtered by Interest - e.g. Gaming)

query.description: UUID of interest category (e.g. Gaming, Cooking)

request.description: Filters discovery candidates who possess the specified interest (e.g. Showing 🎮 Gaming ⓧ) without altering user's own onboarding interests.
Submits a Like (Interested) swipe on target discovery candidate. Returns isMatched=true and matchId if reciprocal like exists.
Submits a Nope (Not my vibe / Not interested) swipe on target discovery candidate. Never creates a match.
Submits a Super Like (Connect star button) swipe on target candidate. Returns match if reciprocal like/super-like exists.

variable.description: UUID of the user whose profile is being viewed

request.description: Retrieves the target user's full profile detail screen (e.g. Meera, 26) including profile photo, verified status, city, distance, Why This Vibe? score and explanation, bio, voice intro audio, moments gallery, interests, shared interests, and bottom action state (myAction, isMatched, canConnect).

variable.description: UUID of the user to block

request.description: Blocks target user. Excludes target from discovery feed, prevents swipes/likes/connections, and restricts mutual profile visibility.

variable.description: UUID of the user to report

request.description: Reports target user for policy violations. Supported reasons: fake_profile, harassment, inappropriate_content, spam, scam, underage, other.
Publishes a new Quick Moment with 1 to 5 images. Automatically calculates a 24-hour expiry timer on the server.

query.description: 'feed' (chronological moments list) or 'stories' (grouped by creator tray)

request.description: Returns all active, non-expired Quick Moments across all users for discovery/feed. Excludes blocked users and inactive accounts.

variable.description: UUID of the user whose moments are requested

request.description: Returns active, non-expired Quick Moment thumbnails for the profile detail screen.
Returns complete full-screen viewer data: creator info, all images in order, caption, relative age, viewer reaction, reaction counts, and reply capability.
Adds or updates an emoji reaction. Supported reactions: heart, love_eyes, fire, laugh, surprised, clap.
Sends a direct reply to the moment creator, delivering it through the direct chat messaging conversation thread.

variable.description: UUID of the target Quick Moment

request.description: Securely submits a report against a Quick Moment with pending review status. Supported reasons: inappropriate_content, nudity, harassment, violence, spam, fake_content, other. Description is optional (max 1000 characters). Deduplicates submissions and prevents self-reporting.

Triggered when user taps the Connect (+) button on a profile detail screen. Creates a connection request, in-app notification, and dispatches a Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notification to the recipient's active devices.
Registers or refreshes the authenticated user's FCM device token for receiving push notifications. Platforms: 'ios' | 'android' | 'web'.
Lists all available interest tags with their icons, categories, and IDs.
